analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI at 46.1 continues to consolidate in neutral territory, and while MACD histogram improved to 308.7655, the uptrend is not yet confirmed. ADX at 29.7 indicates a clear trend forming, but the small difference between DI values suggests directional uncertainty. Volume increased by 1.40x the 5-day average, but price volatility remains limited. Confirmation needed on breaking the 95,680 KRW swing resistance.
